'''Sayaka Senbongi''' (Japanese: '''千本木彩花''' ''Senbongi Sayaka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.  

==Biography==
Senbongi was born on November 24, 1995, in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she gained several roles, with her most notable roles being [[Chrysa]] and [[Goh's Sobble]]. Senbongi is currently affiliated with {{wp|I'm Enterprise}}. She won Best Rookie Actress during the {{wp|11th Seiyu Awards}} of 2017. On December 29, 2019, her agency announced in a statement that she and the fellow voice actor [[Tasuku Hatanaka]] had gotten married.
